objective: Prevent a false public/FINAL metadata claim on v1.5.2+ when the signed-installer and clean Smart App Control-on Sandbox acceptance gates are unmet

baselineNegativeTest.fixture: temporary minimal metadata/source copy only, no installed or network mutations

change.scope: v1.5.2 and higher, v1.5.1 historical audit behavior intentionally unaffected

limitations: Source metadata consistency is not cryptographic signature verification
Signature status can only be validated against actual signed installer through Windows distribution audit
An independently enforced Smart App Control Sandbox and installed service/registry/manifest checks are still mandatory
No eligible signing identity or genuine publisher certificate currently available
Repository root has no LICENSE; open-source signing eligibility cannot be assumed
dependencies: Public trust signing and signed installer hash
risk: Do not disable Smart App Control, forge signing trust, or promote metadata by bypassing independent checks
